not_listed_reason: Taken out of the player catalog on the owner's call (2026-09-08): the picker ships one scenario. The starter itself is unchanged and still registrable by id; set `listed` to true to put it back, the authored titles and blurbs are below.

blurb.zh-Hans: 1916 年的意大利阿尔卑斯前线，一支山地巡逻队奉命穿过冰川，去侦察一处几夜前枪声骤停、从此再无音讯的奥军阵地。冰隧道的尽头封着不该被打开的东西。无需模组 PDF，建好调查员即可开场。
blurb.en: The Italian Alpine front, 1916. A mountain patrol is sent across the glacier to an Austrian position that fell silent after a night of gunfire, and finds at the end of an ice tunnel something that was sealed there long before the war. Playable without the scenario PDF.
